The connection point between the handle and the cup body is slightly soft and lacks the sharp structural definition expected in a macro shot, though this could also be attributed to depth-of-field blur.

To audit the continuity of the rim and the structural integrity of the handle attachment, ensuring no floating pixels or melting edges.
To verify the physical contact between the cup and saucer and ensure the background bokeh does not bleed into the foreground object incorrectly.
